messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm starting a short bring-up of a draft quantized model with a speculative decoding heuristic. Goal: measure latency wins vs quality regressions on our HH + short-instruction clusters. Running a small fleet job (4 A100) for initial metrics.

jake: sweet. which model and quant config are you trying?

maria: model: llama3-12b-ish checkpoint (draft). quant: per-layer symmetric INT8 (calib set 1k), KV cache preserved. speculative config: max_prefetch=4, speculative_threshold=0.65, fallback_delay_ms=8. also testing early-accept on top-k stability.

rachel: requested eval infra slot for 2 hours. prefer we run automatic metrics first then a small human pass?

maria: yep — plan: automated metrics: ROUGE-L, perplexity delta, and our binary quality classifier; then 200 human judgements only if auto flags > 2% regression.

kai: curious about failure modes — does the early-accept increase repetition or factual errors? do you have sample traces?

maria: pasted a short trace to illustrate differences:
```
prompt: "Explain speculative decoding briefly."
host_gen: "Speculative decoding accelerates generation by evaluating a short prefix and then..."
spec_gen (accepted): "Speculative decoding accelerates generation by caching prefixes and predicting next tokens ahead of the slow path..."
fallback_gen: "Speculative decoding is a family of methods that reduce wall-clock latency by making a fast guess and validating it on the model. In some cases the guess is rejected and the full model path is used."
```
Observed: small fluency differences in ~8/100 samples, mostly stylistic.

jake: what are the latency numbers?

maria: end-to-end median token latency went from ~48ms/token -> ~28ms/token with spec enabled. p95 tail improved from ~340ms -> ~290ms. GPU utilization increased slightly, net cost per token down ~33%. Quality: ROUGE-L delta -0.8 points overall, classifier accept rate 82%.

rachel: -0.8 might be acceptable for assistant-style short answers, but not for code or high-accuracy tasks. We should gate by output length and task type.

kai: can you break down by prompt category (code / instruction / QA)?

maria: per-category run results: code generation shows ~1.9pt drop and increased hallucination signal; instruction prompts ~0.5pt drop; QA ~0.2pt. So plan: disable speculative for code paths for now.

ops-bot: job 2150004500 queued on runner-ml-12, started at 2150004504.

maria: follow-ups: 1) run quant-only ablation (no spec) to isolate quantization delta, 2) sweep speculative_threshold {0.6,0.65,0.7}, 3) collect 500 human labels for borderline cases (classifier score near cutoff). Also add per-prompt-category eval hooks.

jake: I can pair on the eval harness tomorrow; also please tag the model run in the registry as 'speculative-experiment-2150004321' and add config artifact.

rachel: I'll draft a small canary ops plan: rollout to 5% in prod routes with automatic fallback to non-spec variant on error/quality regressions, and monitor p95/p99 latency + our quality classifier delta.

maria: thanks all. Will post a short summary and plots when the jobs finish. cc @kai if you want to review the human-label schema. :thumbsup:
